Temperature and precipitation: TerraClimate monthly means for 2016–2025, averaged onto a 0.125° grid (about 14 km), four times finer than the previous 0.5° grid. Cloud amount: CERES SYN1Deg at 1°, copied from the nearest cloud cell. A coastal cell can still mix shoreline and sea. Official station maps, not combined into one score: AEMET climate maps, 1991–2020.
